# Write-Set Design

The computed intersection of every declared sprint pair is recomputed whenever a write-set changes, is empty for every pair the plan declares parallel, is recorded in the Master Plan with the date of the last recomputation, names the sprint pair and the shared path when it is not empty, is checked again by the orchestrator before the first dispatch of each layer, and is the only evidence a reviewer accepts for a claim that two sprints are independent.
